metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS interpretation and response-guidance profile

scope: A metadata-only response layer for the 30 UTILITY-03 priority indicators. It separates source-stated protocols from analyst-advisory data-review workflows.

officialProtocolStatus: Not identified in cited indicator metadata

rules: Official response guidance requires an exact official SOP or guideline source, version and locator.
An indicator threshold or target does not by itself establish a response protocol.
Analyst-advisory review steps remain visibly distinct from official actions.
Guidance never substitutes for clinical judgment, emergency action, programme authority or local escalation policy.
No observed value is assessed and no automated action is authorized.
publicationBoundary: Metadata-only guidance. No clinical decision support, automated alerting, performance rating, observed values or public bulk-download controls.
